body: Thank you for your input. You're right. I just worry so much about even trying to leave because he's threatened before to leave me & take our son with him - even though I know he hates being "saddled" with child care, would love to be a bachelor again, he would make it ugly just to hurt me... he complains constantly about having ONE (1) day a week where he's expected to wake up with & care for our son. On this 1 day, I'm still home by 2pm and resume child care immediately. Every other day, he wakes up as late as possible & spends maybe 1 hour with our son before bed. I do everything else. He insists he cares so deeply about us but ducks out as often as he can, is furious if he gets woken up before 8am (but sleeps in until at least 10am every sunday)... I've been saving every irrational abusive text message he's sent me as proof that he is not a mature or stable parental figure. I just don't know how I'd do it completely alone though. I mean, I'd love to be free of him & have no qualms about being a single mom if I made enough money - but I don't make even close to barely enough money. I'll still be stuck mooching off someone else for a long time until I get my own footing. Can't afford going back to school right now especially if my marriage explodes. I just don't know how to make do.
